question: For the finite m=2 homogeneous bosonic canonical action, can one common N-i0 or N+i0 prescription integrate both real gravitational and scalar momenta first; if not, do the declared steepest Gaussian rays reproduce the configuration action and where does the negative-arm orientation glue enter?

repository_sources.role: Lorentzian action, H_L, T=iN and p_L=i p_E convention
signature (-,+) configuration rays and the independently normalized C/|N| versus holomorphic C/N boundary mismatch
finite midpoint canonical action, exact momentum elimination and Schur complement
declared lapse-dependent gravity/scalar momentum rays and explicit warning that the retained conformal momentum was removed in the cited source
fixed-a scalar-only ablation target on nonzero below-origin lapse arms

primary_sources.source: Banihashemi and Jacobson, On the lapse contour, Phys. Rev. D 111, 066014 (2025), arXiv:2405.10307
primary_sources.used_for: full-real lapse and momentum-first below-origin prescription after the negative gravitational trace momentum is gauge-fixed away
primary_sources.not_used_for: a real p_a contour, a global maximal-slicing theorem, the repository field lift, determinant orientation or n_sigma

primary_sources.source: Witten, Analytic Continuation Of Chern-Simons Theory, arXiv:1001.2933
primary_sources.used_for: relative-cycle and oriented intersection framework only
primary_sources.not_used_for: selection of this finite minisuperspace cycle

primary_sources.source: Gibbons, Hawking and Perry, Path Integrals and the Indefiniteness of the Gravitational Action, Nucl. Phys. B 138 (1978) 141
primary_sources.not_used_for: the finite m=2 orientation ledger computed here

model.hbar: positive real symbol; numerical checks set hbar=1
model.lapse: z=N-i*epsilon for the lower lateral or z=N+i*epsilon for the upper lateral; z is nonzero

source_and_target_cycles.lapse_first_source: N in R oriented -infinity to +infinity, x and q real, all four momenta real, interpreted distributionally before any momentum-first interchange
source_and_target_cycles.ordered_orientation: dp_a0 wedge dp_phi0 wedge dp_a1 wedge dp_phi1 wedge dx wedge dq wedge dN

exact_plan.all_real_lateral_test: For z=N-i*epsilon the real p_phi quadratic is damped and real p_a grows; for z=N+i*epsilon the real p_a quadratic is damped and real p_phi grows. No one lateral sign damps both real blocks.
exact_plan.cap_glue: Transport theta from 0 to plus or minus pi. The two p_a and two p_phi ray Jacobians multiply to +1, while the one x and one q configuration-ray Jacobians multiply to -1.
exact_plan.flat_kernel: After the finite momentum pushforward and flat x,q convolution, the independently normalized real kernel is C/|N| while one holomorphic sheet is C/N, C=sqrt(mu_g*mu_s)/(2*pi*hbar). The negative-arm -1 is configuration/determinant-line glue, not a second momentum Jacobian.
exact_plan.orientation_mutation: Reverse exactly one momentum ray orientation; the ordered Gaussian result must flip sign.

numerical_plan.check: Parameterize the original square-completion remainder on each centered steepest ray, perform four independent one-dimensional high-precision quadratures, and compare their product with J_g*J_s.

decision_table.condition: no common all-real lateral regulator exists, both centered ray blocks reproduce the exact configuration pushforward, momentum cap glue is +1, configuration cap glue is -1, and the scale-factor relative ends remain unproved
decision_table.meaning: Reject the literal all-real momentum-first source link; retain the declared finite Gaussian pushforward only as a branch requiring a conformal prescription and independent determinant-line/BFV completion.

decision_table.condition: one common lateral prescription damps every real momentum block and the exact pushforward and orientation checks pass
decision_table.meaning: The reduced all-real source survives this necessary convergence test, without establishing the full relative ends or BFV cycle.

decision_table.condition: a centered Gaussian ray fails to reproduce the exact Schur/Legendre pushforward or the independently computed orientation ledger
decision_table.meaning: Reject this finite m=2 canonical-to-configuration construction.

decision_table.condition: the exact and independent numerical checks do not select one of the prior rows
decision_table.meaning: Keep the source-link problem open without changing a physical or global claim.

computed_scope: finite m=2 midpoint canonical algebra at nonzero complex lapse
real-axis convergence signs for both lateral prescriptions

lower and upper half-turn momentum/configuration glue
flat kinetic C/|N| versus C/N ablation
not_computed: deformation of the lapse-first all-real distribution to the declared momentum thimbles
a_1=0, A=0, a_1 to infinity or mixed scale-field relative ends
nonlinear configuration-cycle admissibility with the Starobinsky potential
gauge fixing of p_a, Faddeev-Popov measure, BFV ghosts or absolute determinant orientation
zero-lapse full distribution, saddle/upward-cycle/Stokes census, cutoff removal or continuum limit
physical_original_cycle, global_n_sigma, physics claim or TOE claim
